description: Scripted multi-turn chat-overhaul acceptance replays. Assertions describe supported state and behavior, not exact prose.

scenarios.title: Umbrella ownership survives restart

turns.content: IC: I lend you my dark blue umbrella while we leave the inn.
I accept Ren's umbrella and promise to keep it dry.
IC: Whose umbrella are you carrying, and what color is it?

turns.content: IC: I paid for our room tonight.
Ren, I will buy you a cinnamon bun tomorrow to repay you.
OOC: Who owes whom, for what, and when?
